title: ReliefWeb Post API schema - job resource

url.description: An immutable, unique identifier in URL format under your organization's domain (e.g., https://myorganization.org/job/12345). Used as the seed to derive the job posting's UUID v5 and link subsequent updates. Must never change after initial submission. It does not need to resolve to a live web page.

uuid.description: The job posting's UUID (version 5, RFC 4122). Compute it as uuid5('8e27a998-c362-5d1f-b152-d474e1d36af2', url), where url is the exact string in this job posting's 'url' property above. Submissions are rejected if the value does not match what the server computes. Example: uuid5('8e27a998-c362-5d1f-b152-d474e1d36af2', 'https://myorganization.org/job/12345') = 'efa7a5ff-a00c-500e-bc5d-d181874dc072'.

title.description: Job title. The best job titles are brief and specific. Please refrain from indicating location, salary and other details in the title, if possible.

allOf.description: No control characters or separators except for spaces.

not.description: No leading, trailing or consecutive spaces.

source.description: Job source as an array containing a single ID from https://api.reliefweb.int/v2/sources.

closing_date.description: Closing date-time (ISO 8601) of the job. Please make sure it matches the closing date on your ad and/or job application portal, if applicable.

body.description:
Job description in markdown or html (supported tags:


    1. ). The description should be long enough and sufficient in order to attract qualified candidates.

allOf.description: No control characters or separators except for spaces and UNIX newlines (\n).

not.description: No leading, trailing or consecutive spaces and new lines (except at the end of a line to support markdown linebreaks).

how_to_apply.description:
Instructions on how to apply for the job in markdown or html (supported tags:


    1. ). Brief and clear instructions how to apply only. Not to be used to duplicate the job description.

allOf.description: No control characters or separators except for spaces and UNIX newlines (\n).

not.description: No leading, trailing or consecutive spaces and new lines (except at the end of a line to support markdown linebreaks).

country.description: Job country(ies) as a list of IDs from https://api.reliefweb.int/v2/countries. Omit this property for remote location, roster/roving or location to be determined.

job_type.description: Job type as an array containing a single ID from https://api.reliefweb.int/v2/references/job-types. For definitions, see https://reliefweb.int/taxonomy-descriptions.

job_experience.description: Job experience as an array containing a single ID from https://api.reliefweb.int/v2/references/job-experience. For definitions, see https://reliefweb.int/taxonomy-descriptions.

career_category.description: Job career category as an array containing a single ID from https://api.reliefweb.int/v2/references/career-categories. For definitions, see https://reliefweb.int/taxonomy-descriptions.

theme.description: Job theme as an array containing a single ID from https://api.reliefweb.int/v2/references/themes. Only select the most relevant theme. For definitions, see https://reliefweb.int/taxonomy-descriptions.
